title: Corporate Storyteller: Recording images that reflect culture and corporate image
image1Description: Recording activity atmospheres and producing video content within the company

section1.heading: Origin and Intent
section1.content: I believe that photos and videos are the most powerful communication tools for telling the story of Company Culture. My intent is to be the person who records important moments and conveys the atmosphere of happiness, success, and professionalism of the company. This is used as a medium to build engagement internally and create a good image for outsiders who come to visit and study our work.

section2.heading: Role and Action
section2.content: I served as a photographer and Video Creator for various activities, from welcoming study groups and interns, recording recreational activities and the annual company trip, to taking care of the full video production process. This included Scriptwriting, finding meaningful camera angles, and actual filming, to get content that best matches the goals of each activity.

section3.heading: Challenges
section3.content: The important challenge was catching 'Candid Moments' that show the real emotions of the participants in environments that are hard to control, such as location lighting or the speed of events. Additionally, I had to use directing and communication skills to make the people being filmed feel relaxed and natural, as well as planning video stories to be short but interesting within a limited time.

section4.heading: Results and Learning
section4.content: My photos and videos were used as the main media in internal communication channels and company Social Media, which helped make the Employer Branding stronger. This experience taught me Visual Storytelling skills and creative communication through video scripts, which helped me convey the value of the work and the organization clearly and artistically.
